entries.title: Psalms 19:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

entries.title: Psalms 19:2
segments: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

entries.title: Psalms 19:3
segments: [There is] no speech nor language, [where] their voice is not heard. {where...: or, without these their voice is heard: Heb. without their voice heard}

words.text: . {where...: or, without these their voice is heard: Heb. without their voice heard}

entries.title: Psalms 19:4
segments: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun, {line: or, rule, or, direction}

entries.title: Psalms 19:5
segments: Which [is] as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, [and] rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

entries.title: Psalms 19:6
segments: His going forth [is] from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

words.text: of it: and there is nothing hid

entries.title: Psalms 19:7
segments: ¶The law of the LORD [is] perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD [is] sure, making wise the simple. {law: or, doctrine} {converting: or, restoring}

entries.title: Psalms 19:8
segments: The statutes of the LORD [are] right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD [is] pure, enlightening the eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 19:9
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD [are] true [and] righteous altogether. {true: Heb. truth}

entries.title: Psalms 19:10
segments: More to be desired [are they] than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb. {the honeycomb: Heb. the dropping of honeycombs}

words.text: . {the honeycomb: Heb. the dropping of honeycombs}

entries.title: Psalms 19:11
segments: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: [and] in keeping of them [there is] great reward.

words.text: Moreover by them is thy servant

entries.title: Psalms 19:12
segments: Who can understand [his] errors? cleanse thou me from secret [faults].

entries.title: Psalms 19:13
segments: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous [sins]; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression. {the great: or, much}

words.text: over me: then shall I be upright

entries.title: Psalms 19:14
segments: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer. {strength: Heb. rock}
